semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in the rapid growth of high-quality crystals essential for semiconductor applications.
summary: Yokohama National University's Ito Laboratory focuses on advanced crystal growth technologies, particularly using chemical vapor deposition to produce high-quality crystals for semiconductor applications. Their innovative methods significantly reduce manufacturing costs and environmental impact while improving material properties for various electronic applications.
capabilities: Rapid crystal growth technology with thickness of 10 to 100 micrometers
High-speed epitaxial growth achieving 1 micron per minute
Manufacturing services for functional materials including phosphors and dielectrics
Development of micrometer-thick scintillators for X-ray imaging devices
